en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman cannot give birth in less than six months’.
en.sarwar: 32. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu’ manner has narrated the following:
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘A woman does not give birth before six months/”
